description: An invitation to join a workspace or accept a file share. Created by the workspace owner or file sharer. Contains a random token that forms part of the shareable link. Supports both workspace membership and document sharing use cases via the type field.

target.description: AT URI of the target resource — a keyring URI for workspace invitations, or a document URI for share invitations.

type.description: Invitation type. 'workspace' grants membership to a keyring. 'share' grants access to a specific document.

role.description: Role to assign when the invitation is accepted. Required for workspace invitations, ignored for share invitations.

token.description: Random token embedded in the shareable link. Used to look up the invitation record.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of times this invitation can be accepted. Omit for unlimited.

uses.description: Current number of times this invitation has been used. Defaults to 0.

expiresAt.description: When this invitation expires. Omit for no expiry.
